decisions.scientific_tables: Follow the scoped upstream policy recorded in deploy/distribution.json; preserve original references, compilation-copyright qualifications and preferred sources without claiming new third-party grants.

documentation_replacement.scope: All 17 user manual pages independently authored from current product contracts and implementation. Old document branding and unused MathJax setup removed; no old screenshots or measured examples delivered.

documentation_replacement.copyright: Copyright (C) 2026 QualPF contributors, to the extent applicable rights exist
documentation_replacement.qualifications: Bibliographic facts, upstream attribution and third-party notices remain. No scientific table, reference fixture, product behavior or historical acceptance record is replaced.

Fast and performance notes have no additional numbered bibliography. Notes are not redistributed; only bibliographic facts and independently written context enter the manual.

mingw_vendor_archive.source_binding: Corresponding-source review completed for the three recorded DLL hashes using original vendor version/patch/configuration metadata and the independently checked full public source/recipe reconstruction. The original resolved factory commit remains unattested; no bit-identical rebuild is claimed. Earlier partial findings below retain their original scope.
mingw_vendor_archive.required_information: No further owner-held factory record is required for this GCC source review. Any new actual package must bind the reviewed DLL hashes to the supplied source/recipe/header materials and original notices; different runtime bytes need a new review.
mingw_vendor_archive.owner_original_records: Unavailable; owner confirmed no original source snapshot or build log. Public evidence has not established the resolved vendor recipe commit.

header_source_followup.remaining_configuration_header: Actual c++config.h, its GNU template, configure inputs and source version/date are retained; factory configure probes were not independently rerun.
header_source_followup.source_scope: Full GNU GCC archive, ten named patches, complete candidate build scripts, MinGW-w64 v11 source and actual SDK C++/target headers are supplied offline.
header_source_followup.qualification: The candidate script commit is not represented as the factory commit. The recipe downloads a mutable v11 branch; the exact original branch checkout and complete runtime source/configuration correspondence remain unverified. No bit-identical rebuild claim.

target_source_followup.qualification: independently compared public reconstruction; complete DLL build/source correspondence remains qualified

complete_target_origin_followup.qualification: All target source/template origins resolved, including vendor zlib patches; complete compiled DLL/source configuration coverage remains unverified. Original partial and failed comparisons retained.

compiled_symbol_and_fetch_followup.qualification: Full exported ABI correspondence and original source-cache behavior verified. This evidence does not by itself assert all unexported compiled input/configuration correspondence or a full compiler/DLL rebuild.

current_corresponding_source_disposition.scope: Only the three GCC DLL hashes recorded above; original vendor base source, all named patches and configure flags, full public build scripts, pinned runtime source and actual preferred header/template inputs.
current_corresponding_source_disposition.basis: Original vendor metadata explicitly identifies GNU GCC 13.1.0, the ten patches and the build options. Independently checked public materials supply those complete inputs and usable scripts. All observed header/source origins and exported ABI names are accounted for; private factory logs and machine-code identity are not prerequisites of this source review.

official_release_payload_identity.qualification: All five SDK tools match the independently verified official release component byte-for-byte. Vendor identity is distinct from complete static-source/CRT coverage.

ifw_container.source_binding: Official SDK byte identity and the public IFW source-tag correspondence are verified. Embedded OpenSSL build metadata identifies VC-WIN64A with /MT; Qt source paths identify tqtc-qtbase. Complete actual static Qt source/patch/build-input coverage and the applicable integrated CRT redistribution basis remain unverified.
ifw_container.required_information: A matching public supplier manifest, complete source/patch and usable configuration/link-input binding, and applicable integrated compiler-runtime redistribution/source-exclusion terms can close the review. Private factory logs or private Visual Studio license records are not mandatory formats. The owner chose read-only public review; no third-party contact or artifact substitution is authorized by that choice.
ifw_container.owner_original_records: Unavailable; owner confirmed no static dependency/build/link or CRT-origin records.
